comment: Everything the app says out loud to a child who cannot read it. A human recording in recordings/<accent>/ui/<id>.mp3 replaces the synthesised voice silently. The rule_* entries are sentence PIECES, not whole rules: the app builds "<au> never comes at the end of a word, so we use <aw>, as in <saw>" from them plus the grapheme and word recordings it already has, which is why 32 rules need 10 clips rather than 32.
